speed.enabledHint: Off by default. When a new lead becomes a contact, a message goes out on its own, if consent, quiet hours, your plan and your wallet allow it.
speed.consentNote: Consent is never assumed. A WhatsApp utility template is a service message. A marketing template, an SMS or an email is marketing: it needs a recorded consent where your workspace requires one, waits out quiet hours, and is blocked for a contact who opted out. A lead that arrives with proof of consent records it.
